title: St. Timothy in Scripture
subtitle: Every verse that names him, and Eusebius
source: Scripture is the King James Version, as the app's Bible carries it, word for word. Every verse that names Timothy (Timotheus in most of them), with the verses round some of them that speak of him, in the order of the books; then Eusebius, Church History III.4.6, tr. Arthur Cushman McGiffert (NPNF II 1, 1890), public domain. CCEL's transcription of each volume read word for word against archive.org's scans of the same printing; where they differ, the printed page is followed. The editions' footnotes, page numbers and running heads, and their marks in the text, are left out; the paragraphs and the numbers at their heads are as printed. The section titles name the place in each book.

sections.title: Acts 16:1-3
paragraphs: Then came he to Derbe and Lystra: and, behold, a certain disciple was there, named Timotheus, the son of a certain woman, which was a Jewess, and believed; but his father was a Greek: Which was well reported of by the brethren that were at Lystra and Iconium. Him would Paul have to go forth with him; and took and circumcised him because of the Jews which were in those quarters: for they knew all that his father was a Greek.

sections.title: Acts 17:14-15
paragraphs: And then immediately the brethren sent away Paul to go as it were to the sea: but Silas and Timotheus abode there still. And they that conducted Paul brought him unto Athens: and receiving a commandment unto Silas and Timotheus for to come to him with all speed, they departed.

sections.title: Acts 18:5
paragraphs: And when Silas and Timotheus were come from Macedonia, Paul was pressed in the spirit, and testified to the Jews that Jesus was Christ.

sections.title: Acts 19:22
paragraphs: So he sent into Macedonia two of them that ministered unto him, Timotheus and Erastus; but he himself stayed in Asia for a season.

sections.title: Acts 20:4
paragraphs: And there accompanied him into Asia Sopater of Berea; and of the Thessalonians, Aristarchus and Secundus; and Gaius of Derbe, and Timotheus; and of Asia, Tychicus and Trophimus.

sections.title: Romans 16:21
paragraphs: Timotheus my workfellow, and Lucius, and Jason, and Sosipater, my kinsmen, salute you.

sections.title: 1 Corinthians 4:17
paragraphs: For this cause have I sent unto you Timotheus, who is my beloved son, and faithful in the Lord, who shall bring you into remembrance of my ways which be in Christ, as I teach every where in every church.

sections.title: 1 Corinthians 16:10-11
paragraphs: Now if Timotheus come, see that he may be with you without fear: for he worketh the work of the Lord, as I also do. Let no man therefore despise him: but conduct him forth in peace, that he may come unto me: for I look for him with the brethren.

sections.title: 2 Corinthians 1:1
paragraphs: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, and Timothy our brother, unto the church of God which is at Corinth, with all the saints which are in all Achaia:

sections.title: 2 Corinthians 1:19
paragraphs: For the Son of God, Jesus Christ, who was preached among you by us, even by me and Silvanus and Timotheus, was not yea and nay, but in him was yea.

sections.title: Philippians 1:1
paragraphs: Paul and Timotheus, the servants of Jesus Christ, to all the saints in Christ Jesus which are at Philippi, with the bishops and deacons:

sections.title: Philippians 2:19-22
paragraphs: But I trust in the Lord Jesus to send Timotheus shortly unto you, that I also may be of good comfort, when I know your state. For I have no man likeminded, who will naturally care for your state. For all seek their own, not the things which are Jesus Christ's. But ye know the proof of him, that, as a son with the father, he hath served with me in the gospel.

sections.title: Colossians 1:1
paragraphs: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, and Timotheus our brother,

sections.title: 1 Thessalonians 1:1
paragraphs: Paul, and Silvanus, and Timotheus, unto the church of the Thessalonians which is in God the Father and in the Lord Jesus Christ: Grace be unto you, and peace, from God our Father, and the Lord Jesus Christ.

sections.title: 1 Thessalonians 3:1-6
paragraphs: Wherefore when we could no longer forbear, we thought it good to be left at Athens alone; And sent Timotheus, our brother, and minister of God, and our fellowlabourer in the gospel of Christ, to establish you, and to comfort you concerning your faith: That no man should be moved by these afflictions: for yourselves know that we are appointed thereunto. For verily, when we were with you, we told you before that we should suffer tribulation; even as it came to pass, and ye know. For this cause, when I could no longer forbear, I sent to know your faith, lest by some means the tempter have tempted you, and our labour be in vain. But now when Timotheus came from you unto us, and brought us good tidings of your faith and charity, and that ye have good remembrance of us always, desiring greatly to see us, as we also to see you:

sections.title: 2 Thessalonians 1:1
paragraphs: Paul, and Silvanus, and Timotheus, unto the church of the Thessalonians in God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ:

sections.title: 1 Timothy 1:1-3
paragraphs: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the commandment of God our Saviour, and Lord Jesus Christ, which is our hope; Unto Timothy, my own son in the faith: Grace, mercy, and peace, from God our Father and Jesus Christ our Lord. As I besought thee to abide still at Ephesus, when I went into Macedonia, that thou mightest charge some that they teach no other doctrine,

sections.title: 1 Timothy 1:18
paragraphs: This charge I commit unto thee, son Timothy, according to the prophecies which went before on thee, that thou by them mightest war a good warfare;

sections.title: 1 Timothy 6:20
paragraphs: O Timothy, keep that which is committed to thy trust, avoiding profane and vain babblings, and oppositions of science falsely so called:

sections.title: 2 Timothy 1:1-5
paragraphs: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, according to the promise of life which is in Christ Jesus, To Timothy, my dearly beloved son: Grace, mercy, and peace, from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord. I thank God, whom I serve from my forefathers with pure conscience, that without ceasing I have remembrance of thee in my prayers night and day; Greatly desiring to see thee, being mindful of thy tears, that I may be filled with joy; When I call to remembrance the unfeigned faith that is in thee, which dwelt first in thy grandmother Lois, and thy mother Eunice; and I am persuaded that in thee also.

sections.title: Philemon 1:1
paragraphs: Paul, a prisoner of Jesus Christ, and Timothy our brother, unto Philemon our dearly beloved, and fellowlabourer,

sections.title: Hebrews 13:23
paragraphs: Know ye that our brother Timothy is set at liberty; with whom, if he come shortly, I will see you.

sections.title: Church History III.4.6
sections.citation: Eusebius, Church History III.4.6, tr. Arthur Cushman McGiffert (NPNF II 1, 1890)
paragraphs: 6. Timothy, so it is recorded, was the first to receive the episcopate of the parish in Ephesus, Titus of the churches in Crete.
